bounded_host_request.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys,re
names=subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","--format","{{.Names}}"],text=True).splitlines()
db=next((x for x in names if re.search(r"postgres|database|db-[0-9]",x,re.I)),None)
if not db:sys.exit(81)
sql="""SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by FROM posting_topics
WHERE chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893)
AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
AND (title ILIKE '%チャット%' OR title ILIKE '%見せ合い%')
ORDER BY chat_id,message_thread_id"""
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec",db,"sh","-c",'psql -qAt -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"',"sh",sql],capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(82)
rows=[x.split("|") for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
video=[x for x in rows if x[0]=="-1002373696859"]
gay=[x for x in rows if x[0]=="-1003770334893"]
v=len(video);g=len(gay)
if v>9 or g>9:sys.exit(83)
sys.exit(100+v*10+g)
PY
